validated_properties: Capability validation now occurs before invoking the score-producing callable, so invalid/stale/wrong-scope launch attempts perform zero scorer work in the contract harness.
The scorer receives an attempt_id deterministically bound to capability digest, block, slot and request-binding digest.
A ScoreResult is digest-bound to capability, request binding, attempt identity, score and observation time; tampering or rebinding is rejected before SLOT preparation.
SLOT persistence still revalidates the live durable capability through prepare_slot_authorized, so a result that was valid at launch can become stale before persistence and will then fail closed.
scope: Validation used the same injected deterministic adapter substrate as the launch-gate contract tests; exact production sibling byte-execution remains pending.

Python object opacity is not a security boundary. The wrapper prevents accidental/structural misuse only when the active runtime routes score work through it; a malicious caller can still inspect objects or import historical lower-level modules.

Stable attempt_id is only an identity contract. A stochastic scorer must actually use that attempt_id as its immutable sampling key, or otherwise provide equivalent deterministic attempt semantics, before duplicate/retry execution can be treated as the same statistical attempt.

This wrapper does not durably reserve a score attempt before compute. Concurrent duplicate authorized launches for one slot remain a potential measurement-validity problem if stochastic outputs can differ and a caller can select among them before first durable SLOT persistence.
frontier: Add a durable LAUNCH/attempt-reservation record or equivalent one-attempt lease before score generation so concurrent duplicate authorized launches cannot create a choose-the-best retry channel.
Run the score-launch wrapper against exact production gate/adapter/V3/K-guard sibling files in a repository-local runtime and verify zero scorer calls for every invalid capability case.
Integrate the concrete durable writer so launch reservation, score result and SLOT persistence have explicit crash/retry semantics; test crash after scorer completion but before SLOT durability.
If production scorers are stochastic, verify that attempt_id deterministically fixes all relevant RNG/runtime inputs or introduce canonical-result verification before evidence admission.
